purpose: D3 as published, in its white-box mode, on the Phase C CSTR-hard cell with seeds 0, 1 and 2, development data only, for the reactor intervention study, which scores models on this cell; every other setting is the frozen plan's (phase_c_d3_hosted_120b_v2). Upstream's loop, prompts and settings: twenty generations, patience twenty, the sixteen best models shown back for reflection, top-p 0.95, and the paper's temperature 0.7; the model with the lowest one-step validation loss is kept, D3's own rule. The model is the hosted gpt-oss-120b, as for the other baselines and our method; it gets no reasoning effort, so the server's default applies, and an 8192-token output limit because its thinking counts against it.
